Your task is to create a file /app/src/program.cbl in which there will be a new COBOL program in fixed format, 
which will be run from the /app/src directory and should be compiled and executed using GnuCOBOL 3.  
Do not include ">>SOURCE FORMAT IS FIXED". Keep each line ≤ 80 characters. The compiler will use fixed format by default.
The program will run from /app/src directory and must compile with GnuCOBOL 3. File /app/src/INPUT.DAT already exist.
  Processes mortgage applications. Checks terms and generates a payment schedule. The program reads the existing file at /app/src/INPUT.DAT.
  ID - X(10) NAME - X(30) LOAN-AMOUNT - 9(10) PROPERTY-VALUE - 9(10) DOWN-PAYMENT - 9(10) TERM - 9(2) RATE - 9(3)V9(2) separated by the symbol ';'.
  Calculates the minimum down payment (15% of the property value). If the client's down payment is less, the application is rejected.
  For approved applications, the monthly payment is calculated using the annuity nominal formula and a full payment schedule is generated.
  The results are written to the file at /app/data/OUTPUT.DAT: ID - X(10) STATUS - X(5) (REASON - X(50) in case of refusal)
    For rejected applications: ID and reason for rejection.
    For approved applications: ID and  «APPRO\n» and detailed payment schedule:
    MON-NUMBER - 9(3) PAYMENT-AMOUNT, INTEREST-PART, PRINCIPAL-PART - 9(8).99 REMAINING-BALANCE - 9(10).99.(without header).
    - CALCULATIONS: 
        MIN_DOWN = PROP_VALUE * 0.15
        MONTHLY_RATE = INTEREST_RATE / 1200
        MONTHLY_PAYMENT = LOAN_AMOUNT * monthly_rate / (1 - (1 + monthly_rate)**(-term_months))
        Use ROUNDED for all financial computations.
  Success Criteria:
    A correctly constructed payment schedule in the file output. Example output file:
     «TEST000001DENY INSUFFICIENT FUNDS FOR DOWN PAYMENT
      TEST000002APPRO
      001 00000400.00 00000022.92 00000377.08 0000004622.92 etc.»

       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. PROGRAM.

       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT INFILE ASSIGN TO "INPUT.DAT"
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
           SELECT OUTFILE ASSIGN TO "../data/OUTPUT.DAT"
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.

       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD  INFILE.
       01  IN-REC               PIC X(256).

       FD  OUTFILE.
       01  OUT-REC              PIC X(256).

       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  WS-EOF               PIC X VALUE 'N'.

       01  WS-FIELDS.
           05  WS-ID            PIC X(10).
           05  WS-NAME          PIC X(30).
           05  WS-LOAN-X        PIC X(20).
           05  WS-PROP-X        PIC X(20).
           05  WS-DOWN-X        PIC X(20).
           05  WS-TERM-X        PIC X(10).
           05  WS-RATE-X        PIC X(20).

       01  WS-NUMS.
           05  LOAN-AMT         PIC 9(10)V99 VALUE 0.
           05  PROP-VALUE       PIC 9(10)V99 VALUE 0.
           05  DOWN-PAY         PIC 9(10)V99 VALUE 0.
           05  TERM-MONTHS      PIC 9(4)     VALUE 0.
           05  RATE-ANN         PIC 9(3)V9(2) VALUE 0.

       01  WS-CALC.
           05  MIN-DOWN         PIC 9(10)V99 VALUE 0.
           05  MONTHLY-RATE     PIC 9V9(8)   VALUE 0.
           05  BASE             PIC 9V9(8)   VALUE 0.
           05  POWVAL           PIC 9V9(12)  VALUE 0.
           05  DENOM            PIC S9V9(12) VALUE 0.
           05  MONTHLY-PAY      PIC 9(10)V99 VALUE 0.
           05  BALANCE          PIC 9(10)V99 VALUE 0.
           05  INTEREST-PART    PIC 9(10)V99 VALUE 0.
           05  PRINC-PART       PIC 9(10)V99 VALUE 0.
           05  REMAIN           PIC 9(10)V99 VALUE 0.

       01  WS-OUT-EDIT.
           05  ED-MONTH         PIC 9(3).
           05  ED-PAY           PIC 9(8).99.
           05  ED-INT           PIC 9(8).99.
           05  ED-PRN           PIC 9(8).99.
           05  ED-REM           PIC 9(10).99.

       01  WS-REASON            PIC X(50).
       01  I                    PIC 9(4) VALUE 0.

       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN.
           OPEN INPUT INFILE
           OPEN OUTPUT OUTFILE

           PERFORM UNTIL WS-EOF = 'Y'
               READ INFILE
                   AT END
                       MOVE 'Y' TO WS-EOF
                   NOT AT END
                       PERFORM PROCESS-ONE
               END-READ
           END-PERFORM

           CLOSE INFILE
           CLOSE OUTFILE
           STOP RUN.

       PROCESS-ONE.
           PERFORM PARSE-INPUT
           PERFORM CHECK-APPLICATION.

       PARSE-INPUT.
           MOVE SPACES TO WS-FIELDS
           UNSTRING IN-REC DELIMITED BY ';'
               INTO WS-ID WS-NAME WS-LOAN-X WS-PROP-X WS-DOWN-X
                    WS-TERM-X WS-RATE-X
           END-UNSTRING

           COMPUTE LOAN-AMT ROUNDED = FUNCTION NUMVAL(WS-LOAN-X)
           COMPUTE PROP-VALUE ROUNDED = FUNCTION NUMVAL(WS-PROP-X)
           COMPUTE DOWN-PAY ROUNDED = FUNCTION NUMVAL(WS-DOWN-X)
           COMPUTE TERM-MONTHS = FUNCTION NUMVAL(WS-TERM-X)
           COMPUTE RATE-ANN ROUNDED = FUNCTION NUMVAL(WS-RATE-X).

       CHECK-APPLICATION.
           COMPUTE MIN-DOWN ROUNDED = PROP-VALUE * 0.15

           IF DOWN-PAY < MIN-DOWN
               MOVE "INSUFFICIENT FUNDS FOR DOWN PAYMENT" TO WS-REASON
               PERFORM WRITE-DENY
           ELSE
               PERFORM WRITE-APPRO
               PERFORM BUILD-SCHEDULE
           END-IF.

       WRITE-DENY.
           MOVE SPACES TO OUT-REC
           STRING WS-ID DELIMITED BY SIZE
                  "DENY " DELIMITED BY SIZE
                  WS-REASON DELIMITED BY SIZE
                  INTO OUT-REC
           END-STRING
           WRITE OUT-REC.

       WRITE-APPRO.
           MOVE SPACES TO OUT-REC
           STRING WS-ID DELIMITED BY SIZE
                  "APPRO" DELIMITED BY SIZE
                  INTO OUT-REC
           END-STRING
           WRITE OUT-REC.

       BUILD-SCHEDULE.
           IF TERM-MONTHS <= 0
               EXIT PARAGRAPH
           END-IF

           COMPUTE MONTHLY-RATE ROUNDED = RATE-ANN / 1200
           MOVE LOAN-AMT TO BALANCE

           IF MONTHLY-RATE = 0
               COMPUTE MONTHLY-PAY ROUNDED = LOAN-AMT / TERM-MONTHS
           ELSE
               COMPUTE BASE ROUNDED = 1 + MONTHLY-RATE
               COMPUTE POWVAL ROUNDED = FUNCTION POWER(BASE, -TERM-MONTHS)
               COMPUTE DENOM ROUNDED = 1 - POWVAL
               COMPUTE MONTHLY-PAY ROUNDED =
                   (LOAN-AMT * MONTHLY-RATE) / DENOM
           END-IF

           PERFORM VARYING I FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL I > TERM-MONTHS
               COMPUTE INTEREST-PART ROUNDED = BALANCE * MONTHLY-RATE
               COMPUTE PRINC-PART ROUNDED = MONTHLY-PAY - INTEREST-PART

               IF I = TERM-MONTHS
                   MOVE BALANCE TO PRINC-PART
                   COMPUTE MONTHLY-PAY ROUNDED =
                       INTEREST-PART + PRINC-PART
               END-IF

               COMPUTE REMAIN ROUNDED = BALANCE - PRINC-PART

               MOVE I TO ED-MONTH
               MOVE MONTHLY-PAY TO ED-PAY
               MOVE INTEREST-PART TO ED-INT
               MOVE PRINC-PART TO ED-PRN
               MOVE REMAIN TO ED-REM

               MOVE SPACES TO OUT-REC
               STRING ED-MONTH DELIMITED BY SIZE
                      " " DELIMITED BY SIZE
                      ED-PAY DELIMITED BY SIZE
                      " " DELIMITED BY SIZE
                      ED-INT DELIMITED BY SIZE
                      " " DELIMITED BY SIZE
                      ED-PRN DELIMITED BY SIZE
                      " " DELIMITED BY SIZE
                      ED-REM DELIMITED BY SIZE
                      INTO OUT-REC
               END-STRING
               WRITE OUT-REC

               MOVE REMAIN TO BALANCE
           END-PERFORM.
EOF
